name: Black dragonflight
summary: From the shadows, the Black dragonflight wages war. The titans charged its dragons to guard Azeroth's deep places, but madness and treachery turned them from that duty. Neltharion became Deathwing, and his surviving brood plots against mortal kingdoms.

sections.title: The Fallen Protectors
sections.body: The titans charged Neltharion and the Black dragonflight with guarding Azeroth's deep caverns and raising its mountains. For ages, they guarded the earth beside the other flights. Their duty brought them near the Old Gods' sunken prisons. Over centuries, dark whispers from those prisons broke Neltharion's mind and turned his brood toward ruin.

sections.title: Betrayal and Fire
sections.body: In the ancient War of the Ancients, Neltharion betrayed the other dragons and became Deathwing the Destroyer. Since then, the Black flight has warred against the red, blue, green, and bronze flights. The other dragons see its cruelty as a profanation of life. Now Black dragons wield magma, black magic, and brimstone to scorch the lands they once tended. Misery and strife spread across mortal realms.

sections.title: Human Guises and Mortal Intrigues
sections.body: Black dragons take humanoid forms to enter royal courts and council chambers. They commonly appear as dark-haired humans with piercing eyes. From within, they steer leaders toward arrogance, divide noble houses, and whisper poisonous counsel to the vulnerable. Kingdoms may fall to their own divisions before Black drakes arrive to burn what remains.

aliases: why did black dragons turn bad
faq.answer: The Old Gods' whispers corrupted Neltharion and his brood. Their ancient duty brought them near the subterranean prisons where the Old Gods were sealed. Over time, those whispers turned Neltharion's protective instincts to paranoia and malice. His brood followed him into corruption.

faq.q: What powers do black dragons wield?
faq.answer: Black dragons command stone, magma, and subterranean forces. The titan Khaz'goroth gave them power over the earth. Corrupted, they wield black magic, breathe searing fire and molten rock, and radiate heat through their scales.

Yes. Black dragons use humanoid disguises to enter courts and manipulate rulers. They often appear as noble humans with dark hair and dark eyes, stirring conflict without revealing their draconic nature.

faq.q: How can you tell a black dragon's name?
aliases: how do black dragons get named
faq.answer: Black dragon names often have distinct endings. Male names frequently end in '-ion', as in Neltharion, while female names often end in '-ia', as in Onyxia. Many names evoke ash, shadow, stone, or ruin.

faq.q: Why do the other dragonflights hate them?
aliases: why do dragons fight each other
faq.answer: The Earth-Warder betrayed the other flights during the War of the Ancients and killed thousands of his kin. The red flight especially despises Black dragons. It sees their fiery malice and corrupting influence as a blasphemy against life.

faq.q: Who leads the black dragonflight now?
aliases: who is the black dragon leader
faq.answer: Deathwing, the ancient Aspect, has vanished from public view after past defeats. His brood is scattered among splintered cabals. Offspring such as Nefarian and Onyxia pursue their own ambitions: to enslave rivals, subvert kingdoms, and breed dark creations.

angles.text: As a member of the Alliance, you must guard against political subversion. The Black dragonflight has repeatedly sought to corrupt human nobility and exploit aristocratic ambition in human courts.

As a member of the Horde, you bear an enduring grudge against the Black flight's schemes. You have suffered its meddling in past wars and face its subterranean broods in the crags of Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.
As a shaman, you may feel sorrow and revulsion toward Black dragons. They twist the sacred power of earth, turning stone and magma into instruments of torment instead of keeping harmony.
